# Data table

Many records in one view, with search, filters, sorting, column choice, selection and paging.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Brand expressive</span> Brand expressive avoids tools people use for hours. Data table is for acting on many records in bulk; here people browse and explore the story. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./card">Card</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** People find, compare and act on many records, often in bulk.
- **Not when:** A handful of rows (a plain table), or items people browse rather than compare (cards).

Instead:

- [Table](./table.md): A few rows, no tools.
- [Card](./card.md): Items to browse, not compare.

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add data-table
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Data table reads 3 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. A row marked Themeable changes between light and dark. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Data table's tokens to change Data table alone.
